user.title: Tuya BLE setup
user.description: Choose User Code to sign in using a QR code, or select Manual setup and fill in the section below.

user_code.name: User Code (recommended)
user_code.description: Sign in with your Smart Life or Tuya Smart app account. No Tuya Developer Platform account is required.

data_description.user_code: In Smart Life or Tuya Smart: Me → ⚙️ Settings → Account and Security → User Code. [Obtaining User Code for sign-in](https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/tuya/#obtaining-user-code-for-sign-in).

manual.name: Manual setup
manual.description: Enter local device credentials when Manual setup is selected.

data_description.address: Bluetooth MAC address in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format
data_description.device_name: Optional friendly name. Leave blank to use the default name.
data_description.local_key: Encryption key used for BLE communication

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.description: Open Smart Life or Tuya Smart, use + → Scan, and scan this QR code. Confirm the login in the app, then select Submit here. To replace an expired QR code, select Generate a new QR code and Submit, then scan the replacement.

account_device.title: Choose your app device
account_device.description: Select the device whose local BLE credentials you want to save. Your app account may also contain Wi-Fi or Zigbee devices; select a supported Tuya BLE device.

device_credentials.title: Confirm local BLE credentials
device_credentials.description: These values were retrieved from your app account. The Bluetooth MAC is filled from a matching advertisement, a Bluetooth MAC returned by Tuya, or the discovery card where you selected Add. Confirm that the selected app device is the same physical device. If no MAC is available, choose a nearby Bluetooth device or enter its MAC. Complete any missing required fields before saving.

data_description.address: Bluetooth MAC address. When setup starts from a discovered device, its address is suggested if no conflicting UUID is known. Confirm that it belongs to the app device you selected.
data_description.device_name: Optional friendly name. Leave blank to use the default name.
data_description.local_key: Encryption key used for BLE communication
data_description.bluetooth_device: Selecting a device here overrides the MAC address field. Keep the default to use the address above.
